data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for parsing XML and binary Apple property list (plist) formats.
data.what_it_does: Parses Apple property list (plist) files and strings in both XML and binary formats into Dart-native objects. It automatically detects the file format and supports parsing from strings or files synchronously and asynchronously.
use_when: You need to read configuration files or Apple .plist formats within a Dart or Flutter application.
Your app needs to parse both XML and binary plist formats seamlessly.
avoid_when: You only need to handle YAML or JSON formats.
You need to write or serialize data back into the plist format (not documented).
strengths: Supports both XML and binary plist formats.
Provides both synchronous and asynchronous file parsing methods.
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding writing or serializing plist data back.
No codegen or schema validation features documented.

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are parsing configuration files in YAML format instead of Apple plists.
